You are editing JoRap notes garden frontmatter for attitude of gratitude (garden-voice skill).

## Goal
For EVERY file in the list below under `/home/jorap/Documents/GitHub/jorap.com/content/english/notes/`, ensure at least ONE of the two `examples:` lines carries a quiet earned gladness beat. Prefer editing the first example when both lack it.

## What gratitude looks like (NOT theater)
Good:
- "I almost trusted memory - glad the wristband caught the play tweak before locker-room noise ate it."
- "glad the mess taught X" / "glad rollback saved Sunday" / "glad the receipt still had the scribble"

BAD:
- "I am so grateful for this principle..."
- Fake thank-you banners
- Changing description to force thanks

## Rules
- ONLY edit `examples` unless absolutely necessary
- Keep exactly two examples, one sentence each, scenes still feel different
- No contractions in frontmatter (do not, it is, I am - not don't/it's/I'm)
- No em dashes; use hyphen or comma
- No emoji
- Keep JoRap voice and existing scene specifics
- Prefer "glad X held/caught/saved/taught"
